firstPlayerRule: Pick a player to go first. The instructions suggest examples such as the furriest player, the player with the most recent tantrum, or the player with the most body parts.
clarifications: The choice is made for the practice round. After the full-game setup, play goes clockwise around the table; the instructions do not call for choosing another starter.
